UP Congress Chief Ajay Rai Placed Under House Arrest in Ayodhya

Uttar Pradesh Congress chief Ajay Rai was reportedly placed under house arrest in Ayodhya ahead of a planned party delegation visit to the Ram Temple. The Congress party stated they had informed local administration of their visit. Rai accused the government of placing him under arrest, with some reports suggesting the move is linked to a controversy over Ram Temple donations.
